LESSON: CLIMATIC REGIONS IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and the Built Environments
Topic 1.3: Climatic regions in Eastern Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Climatic regions in Eastern Africa. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can climate influence our day-to-day activities?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa on a map
2. describe characteristics of the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa
3. explain ways in which climate influences human activities in Eastern Africa

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: CLIMATIC REGIONS IN EASTERN AFRICA
This lesson teaches Climatic regions in Eastern Africa for Grade 6 SOCIAL STUDIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa on a map
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. describe characteristics of the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. explain ways in which climate influences human activities in Eastern Africa
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Climatic regions in Eastern Africa using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa above.
2. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Climatic regions in Eastern Africa important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can climate influence our day-to-day activities?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa on a map
2. describe characteristics of the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa
3. explain ways in which climate influences human activities in Eastern Africa
